original_test_intent: Exercise all intended AMD XGMI fabric links with the approved AGFHC recipe and prove explicit PASS plus measured bandwidth above the authoritative target without fabric or GPU health degradation.
original_method: Capture the live GPU/socket/XGMI link topology, link state, firmware/driver and compatible AGFHC identity; approve xgmi_lvl2 or an explicitly mapped level and its target/unit/window, quiesce competing GPU traffic, record baseline errors/health, run the recipe once under maintenance with continuous monitoring, compare complete per-link/all-link measurements to targets and verify post-run topology/link/GPU/thermal/power health.
manual_activity: The owner approves topology, recipe level, target and dedicated maintenance; an operator monitors the XGMI/GPU fabric run; the owner reviews coverage, measured-versus-target values and health and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/GPU/socket/XGMI link topology and expected all-link coverage
Compatible AGFHC version and approved XGMI recipe/level
Per-link or aggregate target bandwidth, units, direction and measurement window
Thermal/power/fabric abort thresholds and console/recovery path
safety_requirements: Use protected access and preserve complete output/exit status
Require approval before XGMI fabric stress and run only on dedicated SUT
Monitor every link, GPU health, thermal, power and kernel/fabric errors
Require explicit Status PASS and measured target comparison, not exit code alone
Stop on link loss/downtrain, error, alarm, hang or instability without blind rerun
Preserve logs and do not reset/reconfigure fabric to force a pass
agent_execution_scope: Collect topology, tool/recipe/target and baseline link/health evidence
Validate all intended XGMI links and output schema before stress
After approval run the selected recipe once with continuous monitoring
Parse per-link/all-link status and bandwidth and verify post-health
Perform no recipe/target invention, uncontrolled stress, fabric recovery or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve XGMI topology, recipe level, target definitions and maintenance controls
Disposition coverage/performance/health anomalies and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: APPROVAL-GATED ALL-LINK XGMI FABRIC BANDWIDTH QUALIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each expected physical XGMI link to an AGFHC result row, direction, target and pre/post health counter, plus aggregate all-link status.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes recipe-level choice and all-link completeness explicit while retaining the source workload and acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single aggregate PASS can conceal an untested or degraded link unless the result is reconciled to the live topology.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fabric load can disturb active GPU work and expose link instability; targets vary by topology, link generation/direction and recipe measurement window.

project_override_considerations: If a different recipe level is selected, the owner must document equivalence or deliberate scope change and supply matching targets. An absent link or missing per-link evidence cannot be silently hidden by aggregate bandwidth.

Approved AGFHC/driver/firmware identities, recipe list/level, topology and per-link targets
Dedicated/no-load approval and baseline XGMI link/error/GPU/thermal/power state
Complete xgmi run output/exit/Status, per-link/all-link measured values/units/targets
No-clear/no-secret/no-retry audit, recovery record and engineer verdict

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2058 Wistron-AMD SVM-00012-V002: approve the live GPU/socket/XGMI all-link topology, compatible AGFHC build and exact xgmi recipe level, authoritative per-link/aggregate target bandwidth with units/directions/window, dedicated no-load maintenance, monitoring/abort limits and non-repeating recovery procedure.

review_improvement: Makes the all-link intent, recipe choice and topology-specific performance oracle explicit and ties them to fabric health.
independent_technical_reasoning: XGMI performance is meaningful only relative to the active link graph and traffic direction; an aggregate number cannot establish that every expected link participated. The source's permission to change recipe level changes stress and coverage, so that choice must be owner-approved rather than automated. AGFHC Status and bandwidth target are separate acceptance conditions, and pre/post fabric counters are needed to rule out a nominal performance pass that created link errors or downtraining.
